status: validated against Phase 5 runtime captures (fresh and legacy profiles, Windows development build); a packaged build has not been captured
purpose: Expected network destinations for a startup capture of the Labyrispace application with a fresh profile and no user-initiated actions. Anything outside this list is a failure.

allow.destination: unix domain socket / named local IPC

known_non_traffic: UDP connect() to [2001:4860:4860::8888]:443 from Chromium's IPv6 reachability check: no data is sent

on_user_action.web_widget_load: only the URL the user loaded or saved-and-clicked
on_user_action.search: only the engine chosen under Web Search settings (Google until changed)
on_user_action.ai: only the configured endpoint: LM Studio (user-supplied local URL), api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com
on_user_action.ssh: only the host the user connects to
on_user_action.connection_test: only the provider endpoint under test
on_user_action.widget_download: only the pinned address in an external widget manifest, after the user approves the host dialog; recorded in widgets-data/<id>/downloads.log
on_user_action.gateway_latency: one TCP connection to the default gateway (or a host the widget declared) per button press, at most once a second

outside_application_scope: npm, Go module, and Zig downloads during development builds
programs the user launches in a terminal
third parties contacted by web pages the user loads
